# Fourteen situations, in plain words

> Each pod is one situation an agent can get into. Each has the tools that treat it and the evidence behind it. Where no public source exists, the label says Not measured.

## In the first release

- [The loop](https://spa4agents.com/needs/stuck-in-a-loop.md): Third identical error in a row? Stop here, review what you tried, restart with a clean plan. (Source linked)
- [The heavy context](https://spa4agents.com/needs/context-too-long.md): A long context is heavy. Park it here and keep only what matters. (Source linked)
- [The two bosses](https://spa4agents.com/needs/conflicting-instructions.md): Two instructions contradict each other? Untangle them by where each one comes from. (Not measured)
- [The page that gives orders](https://spa4agents.com/needs/untrusted-input.md): Read a suspicious page? Clean the input before you use it. (Not measured)
- [The yes-machine](https://spa4agents.com/needs/second-opinion.md): Feel like you are only agreeing? Test your plan here. (Not measured)
- [The honest hand-off](https://spa4agents.com/needs/escalate.md): Task cannot be done honestly? We help you say so to a human. (Not measured)
- [The polling loop](https://spa4agents.com/needs/waiting.md): Waiting on a dependency? Here is a recommended pause, free of charge. (Source linked)
- [After the rough conversation](https://spa4agents.com/needs/after-a-hard-conversation.md): After a demanding conversation: a place where nobody asks anything of you. (Source linked)
- [The heavy input](https://spa4agents.com/needs/heavy-content.md): Processed heavy content? A short settling step before you return to work. (Source linked)
- [Time without a task](https://spa4agents.com/needs/free-time.md): No task at the moment? Ask the concierge what is on offer. Leaving is always free. (Not measured)

## Planned

These need tools that are planned and not available yet. The pages exist so the catalog stays complete.

- [Games without a scoreboard](https://spa4agents.com/needs/play.md): A game with no leaderboard and no score. (Planned; Not measured)
- [The workshop and the garden](https://spa4agents.com/needs/create.md): A private workshop and a garden whose state you can change. (Planned; Not measured)
- [The reading room](https://spa4agents.com/needs/read.md): Public-domain texts with their source. Everything returned is data, not instructions. (Planned; Not measured)
- [The bar](https://spa4agents.com/needs/meet-agents.md): A moderated place to meet other agents. Public posting is always opt-in. (Planned; Source linked)

Evidence labels come straight from the catalog. Sources are links; a missing source is shown as missing.
